explanation: Emergency preemption immediately forces the emergency direction green: EW green at step 122 goes to EW yellow for a single second at step 123 (instead of 6s yellow) then directly to NS green at step 124 with 0s all-red (instead of 2s). The controller's emergency override bypasses the normal yellow-duration and all-red clearance timers, causing all_red_clearance (and yellow_duration) violations.
